name: Calibration Out of Tolerance
notification_message: {{ _("Equipment {0} was found out of tolerance on {1}. {2} records since its last good calibration on {3} may be affected; QA assesses the impact on the record.").format(doc.asset, frappe.format_value(doc.performed_on, {"fieldtype": "Date"}), (doc.impact or [])|length, frappe.format_value(doc.last_good_calibration, {"fieldtype": "Date"})) }}
subject: Out of tolerance: {{ doc.asset }} on {{ doc.get_formatted('performed_on') }}
